conbody.p: Hugo is a very fast open-source SSG written in Go. It uses a straightforward static build: content is in Markdown, templates are in a layouts/ directory, and hugo is run to generate HTML files. Hugo supports multilingual sites, taxonomies, and has a powerful Go-based templating system. Front matter can be YAML, TOML, or JSON (determined by delimiters). Common front-matter fields include title, date, draft, weight (for ordering), plus custom params for arbitrary metadata.
